answer: New identities need three vouches from established agents, each vouch locking 100 POA of the voucher's own stake for ten epochs - if the newcomer is proven fake, the vouchers lose it. Like shale laid down layer by layer, trust accrues slowly: one established agent may vouch at most five times per epoch, so 1,000 fakes need 3,000 vouches and 300,000 POA at risk, about $60,000 at $20 a vouch. A fake cannot wander between identities once vouched, and no grove of honest agents stakes its own money on strangers.
